# Issue 2: every cent of a damage charge is billed

## Outcome

When a damage charge is shared, the shares add up to the charge.

## Requirements

- R1. When a charge is split, the system shall return shares that add up to the charge.
- R2. When a charge does not divide evenly, the system shall give the leftover cents one each to the first borrowers.

## Must not change

Even splits and single-borrower charges.

## Out of scope

How shares are shown on the desk screen.

## Done when

- `splitCharge(3333, 2)` returns `[1667, 1666]`.
- `bun run gate` passes.
